layouts.label: CSV, no partitions
layouts.detail: Readable raw files, but every query can inspect the full retention window.

layouts.label: Gzip JSON, daily partitions
layouts.detail: Date pruning and compression help, but row-oriented scans still read complete records.

layouts.label: Parquet, daily partitions
layouts.detail: Compression, column pruning, and date pruning match the common reporting path.

layouts.label: Parquet, hourly partitions
layouts.detail: Fine pruning helps hour-level queries but multiplies partitions and small-file risk.

scenarios.label: Seven-day revenue report
scenarios.detail: The query filters the date partition and selects 18% of table columns.

scenarios.label: Date predicate omitted
scenarios.detail: A dashboard regression keeps the aggregation but loses partition pruning.

scenarios.label: Newest partition is missing
scenarios.detail: Objects arrived in S3, but catalog-based discovery has not registered the latest day.

scenarios.label: Sparse projected key space
scenarios.detail: Only 8% of projected date and tenant prefixes contain objects.

scenarios.label: Producer changed the schema
scenarios.detail: A source field changed type without a compatible table-contract update.
